Panzer Knights: Commander's Edition - Gameplay Overview Trailer | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10015943

Lead a German Panzer platoon through the chaos of World War II in this definitive version of the intense, anime-inspired tank simulation. Assemble an elite crew, deploy legendary tanks, and survive fierce engagements where cunning and skill will decide victory or defeat. 

Includes three additional bonus tank packs! Take command of the US army’s ‘M4-748 Sherman’ and ‘M26 Pershing’, field the British ‘Churchill VII’, and ‘Valentine XI’, and deploy the Axis’s long-range tank destroyer ‘Elefant’ and super-heavy ‘Panzer VIII Maus’.

Coming to PlayStation 5 on August 13th 2026!

text:
Dune: Awakening - September Release Deep Dive | PS5 Games
https://www.playstation.com/games/dune-awakening/

Dune: Awakening is an Open World Survival game with immersive adventure and RPG gameplay coming to PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 5 Pro on September 22nd! The PlayStation release will see a host of new additions including a full single-player mode and and a ton more gameplay customization options. This release will also benefit from all the enhancements and additions made to the PC version over the past year, making this the most evolved version of Dune: Awakening ever. Check out the Deep Dive to learn more!

Wishlist and pre-order Dune: Awakening today on the PlayStation Store.

Explore, build, craft, and unravel a cinematic Dune story alone or with friends as you rise from survival to greatness on the most legendary planet in the universe. 

Just remember: the sandworm always comes.
